articles.summary: 24/7 Wall St.: Intel Jumps 8%, AMD Rises 3%: A $14.2 Billion Fab Deal and AI Momentum Lift the Chip Sector. The chip sector is rallying Wednesday morning, with Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) shares up 8% and Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) stock rising 3% in early trading. The two moves reflect distinct catalysts, but together they signal that investors are choosing company-specific optimism over macro caution today.
